title: Bilevel Optimization for Covert Memory Tampering in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Architectures (XAMT)
authors: Akhil Sharma; Shaikh Yaser Arafat; Jai Kumar Sharma; Ken Huang
why_relevant: Proposes a bilevel optimization framework for covert poisoning of RAG knowledge bases (XAMT-RAG), evaluated on SafeRAG, directly relevant to adversarial corruption of retrieval memory.
why_not_or_caveat: Half the paper focuses on MARL replay buffers, not RAG; experimental section is largely protocol rather than results.
